decisions.accuracyFloor: Native-grid final affine refinement is the default. A shrink-two final refinement measured about 1.0 mm landmark RMS on the analytic oracle and failed the frozen 0.8 mm gate.
decisions.galeBoundary: No Gale source change. The hot path is registration scoring and image sampling; the small 4x4 affine control algebra runs once per initialization and does not justify a registration-shaped Gale primitive.
decisions.midpoint: The fixed-to-moving and inverted moving-to-fixed fits are reconciled by an affine-group midpoint, then split into opposite inverse half maps before nonlinear refinement.
decisions.objective: Every candidate is scored in both directions with clipped gain/offset-invariant correlation and explicit overlap admission.

environment.contentionNote: Unrelated local development servers and agent processes were present. No ANTs, Docker benchmark, or second HalfFlow JMH process was run concurrently.

numericalAdmission.recovery: The independently generated analytic physical-world fixture passes the 0.8 mm four-landmark RMS gate after robust affine estimation.
numericalAdmission.split: A supplied affine and its inverse produce exchanged midpoint arms, and midpoint composition recovers both affine directions.
numericalAdmission.swap: Repeating estimation with fixed and moving exchanged yields the inverse transform and exchanged midpoint arms within 2e-6 mm.
numericalAdmission.support: Constant images fail at the typed insufficient-support boundary.
